text:
Type: white wall shelf with wooden brackets
Use: displaying books, plants and decor; living room, bedroom, home office, hallway
Style: Scandinavian, farmhouse, minimalist
Materials: white painted shelf board, solid birch brackets with diagonal braces
Colors: white, light natural birch
Shape: long flat white board on two angled wooden brackets that show below, simple triangle supports, clean straight edges, light and open
Feel: fresh, homely, airy, simple
Goes with: white walls, light wood, green plants, ceramics; Scandinavian, farmhouse or Japandi rooms
